categories_thin: Med spas / aesthetic injectables - a September-2026 survey by Garden State Circle found no med spa with premises inside Franklin Township; 'Somerset' med-spa addresses it checked fall in North Brunswick or Piscataway. Only Derma Laser Center and similar skin-care practices cover part of that demand.
Day spas - very few true day spas inside the township; most 'spa' names here are nail or hair salons adding spa services, plus massage-only studios.

Yoga studios - no dedicated yoga studio with a commercial address inside the township was found; listings returned studios in North Brunswick, Bound Brook, Edison and Warren, plus home-based teachers that were excluded as residential.
Veterinarians - only two practices inside the township; the surrounding cluster sits in Bridgewater, South Plainfield, Piscataway and Metuchen.
Optometrists/ophthalmologists - very thin for a township this size: one independent optometry practice plus one solo ophthalmologist and an optical/eye-care shop.
Physical therapy - dominated by regional brands (Ivy Rehab, Professional PT, Atlantic PT, Alliance), so few clearly independent PT practices remain; body-shop-style PT clinics may be undercounted.
Dermatology - only one small independent practice found (Dermcare); Rutgers Health Dermatology and Schweiger are hospital-system/large-group offices and were excluded.
caveats: Somerset is a postal name, not a municipality: mail addressed to Somerset 08873 is delivered in Franklin Township, so every 'Somerset' address here is inside the zone. Franklin Park (08823) and East Millstone are also postal names inside the township.
The 10-mile radius from central Milltown covers the whole township (farthest edge, near Griggstown/Kingston, is roughly 9-10 miles out), so nothing was cut for distance.

Excluded as national/regional chains or franchises: Crunch Fitness, Planet Fitness, Sport Clips, Fantastic Sams, The Max Challenge, Ivy Rehab, Hand & Stone, Target Optical, Visionworks, America's Best, CityMD, AFC Urgent Care, PetSmart grooming, Club Pilates, LA Fitness. Dental365 and The Smilist dental offices and 'Professional PT' were kept but flagged BORDERLINE so the triage team can drop them.
Where phone is 'Unknown', the directories used do not publish it; triage should pull it from the business's own site or Google profile.

Many Somerset businesses share building addresses (441 Elizabeth Avenue salon suites, 853/745 Hamilton Street, 994 Easton Avenue, 13 Clyde Road therapy suite, 75 Veronica Avenue medical suites). They are listed separately because they are separate businesses, but expect a shared landlord rather than a duplicate.

Several closures/renames are likely in the older salons and barbershops: pairs such as R & J Glamour / Juanita's (same suite), Don Andres / Golden Luxury Cuts (same address), Cutters / LoczbyLiz / La Perle (same address) may be the same premises under different names over time - analysts should confirm which is current.

'Franklin Township' searches constantly pull in Franklinville (Gloucester County) and Franklin borough (Sussex County) results; all such entries were filtered out by address. A few township businesses at the tail of those directory lists may therefore be missing.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable (two mirrors timed out), so no OSM sweep was done.
Yellow Pages, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, Cybo, FindOpen, LocalityBiz and loc8nearme category pages returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare blocks via both fetch and the browser.
Google Maps in the browser served only a four-result 'limited view' per query and would not scroll or paginate, so Maps could not be used for a full sweep of any category.

BestProsInTown lists roughly 3-17 businesses per category (it appears to cap the list) and merges same-named towns in other states; the township's tail-end listings in dense categories (nail salons, barbershops, hair salons) may be incomplete.
No township-issued business licence, registry or economic-development directory covering these categories was found on franklintwpnj.org.

Psychology Today and Healthgrades were read only through search-result summaries for some practitioners; individual profile pages were not all opened, so a few therapist/physician entries rest on one listing.
Somerset Taekwondo and Little Wonders Pediatrics publish no street address on the pages read; both are included with address 'Unknown' rather than guessed.
